title: Mac CLI: transcribe, install_mac, cross-platform transcribe hook, generate-from-image --prompt
paragraphs:

title: refactor: rename project to mikerosoft and move tools to tools/
vid2md: add YouTube-to-markdown clipboard tool
paragraphs: Right-click any file or folder in Explorer, Mike's Tools > Video to Markdown. Small topmost WinForms dialog prompts for a YouTube URL (pre-filled from clipboard if present), calls the video-to-markdown API in a background PS runspace so the marquee progress bar animates, copies the markdown image-link to clipboard, shows a Windows toast, then auto-closes after 1.5s with a green success label.
.url Internet Shortcut files handled silently (no UI). CLI mode also supported: vid2md <url> or vid2md <file.url>.
Context menu registered on AllFilesystemObjects (covers all files and folders), Directory, Directory\Background, video extensions, and .url files via HKCU\Software\Classes.
